page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.32xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores and 128 vCPUs, utilizing a 1-to-1 thread-to-core ratio with no hyperthreading. The instance is powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include any bundled local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage volumes. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. The absence of local NVMe storage and dedicated GPU hardware represents a clear tradeoff, positioning this instance away from storage-intensive database workloads or hardware-accelerated machine learning training.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g7.32xlarge offers high resource density for enterprise workloads requiring massive parallel processing without the overhead of hyperthreading. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance. This configuration is suitable for large-scale web applications, enterprise application servers, containerized microservices, and general-purpose workloads that demand high CPU core counts and a balanced memory profile.
